create_pose_config: create a PoseConfig dataclass with model complexity, smoothing, and confidence threshold settings
setup_pose_extension: setup a PoseExtension instance with MediaPipe pose detection using custom PoseConfig parameters
process_frame_pose: process a numpy array frame through MediaPipe pose detection and return pose landmarks
draw_pose_overlay: draw pose landmarks and connections on a frame using MediaPipe drawing utilities
check_pose_output: validate that pose detection results contain 33 landmarks per entry in the ExtensionResult
